Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_Enabled_tooltip: Enable room designations and editing. Existing private storage policies remain fail-closed if unavailable.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_RoomTileLimit_tool: Maximum tiles in one saved logical room. Existing larger rooms remain readable; edits must fit the current limit.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_RoomEditRange_tool: Maximum horizontal tile distance for editing room geometry. Native access and per-floor membership still apply.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_RoomDoorways_toolt: Treat verified doorless frames as structural detection boundaries. Actual doors remain boundaries even when open.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_DelegatedRooms_too: Allow delegated private room storage policies for integrated mods. This does not secure unrelated vanilla actions. Existing private policies fail closed when disabled.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_CleanBuildingEnabl: Allow server-authoritative cleaning consumers to request a loaded native building. Native and delegated cleaning permissions still apply.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_CleaningBorrowSupp: Allow cleaning jobs to borrow exact eligible supplies from configured storage in the selected building.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_CleaningReturnSupp: Return borrowed supplies to their original storage only when it remains valid, permitted and has room. Otherwise retain them and report the reason.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_CleaningBleachML_t: Bring the bucket's bleach to this volume first, then fill the 10 L bucket with water. Default 10 mL. Measured residual bleach counts toward the dose on a refill.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_CleaningBuildingTi: Maximum loaded interior tiles in one cleaning job. Larger or incomplete buildings are refused, never silently truncated.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDRooms_CleaningTransferSe: Base time to fetch or return one cleaning supply item. Higher values slow the job. Normal character timing modifiers still apply. Default: 1 second.
